name: Arkansas Electrical Outlet Inc
old_description: Arkansas Electrical Outlet, Inc. has been independently owned and operated since 1997, specializing in new and remanufactured electrical supplies and custom-built systems for a variety of industries and clients worldwide.
about:
Arkansas Electrical Outlet, Inc. was founded in 1997 in Forrest City, Arkansas, and has remained independently owned and operated since its inception. The company began as a supplier of electrical equipment and has expanded to offer both new and remanufactured products along with custom-built systems for customers worldwide.

The company’s core offerings include a broad range of electrical apparatus such as buckets, control panels, panel and switchboards, switches and disconnects, bus plugs, motor control equipment, transformers, circuit breakers, motor starters, pump panels, and variable frequency drives. In addition to supplying these components, AEO provides sand blasting and powder coating services and performs custom manufacturing to meet specific client requirements. The facility also handles remanufacturing of electrical supplies, though the company does not disclose its plant size, headcount, or annual production volumes.

AEO serves a variety of industries and clients globally, though the company does not specify particular sectors in its public materials. Its product lineup suggests a focus on industrial, commercial, and utility electrical infrastructure. The recent acquisition by Group CBS brings additional resources, including access to what is described as the largest inventory of low- and medium-voltage apparatus and replacement parts in the United States, along with engineering support, training, remote racking and switching solutions, and specialty test equipment.

The company emphasizes competitive pricing, timely delivery, and a commitment to meeting customer needs faster and more affordably than competing manufacturers. This value proposition, combined with the expanded capabilities from the Group CBS partnership, forms the basis of its market positioning.
